-- ============================================================
-- test-12-result_pos.fh  –  Result PASS-Tests (RES-01..07)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Results.Pos

import Test.Support exposing Point, make_point, NotFound, InvalidInput

-- RES-01: return ok expr
function ok_integer(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n >= 0
ensures success, value = n
is
    return ok n
end ok_integer

-- RES-01: return ok array-literal
function ok_array(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Result<Array<Integer, 2>, NotFound>
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
ensures success, value[0] = a, value[1] = b
is
    return ok [a, b]
end ok_array

-- RES-02: return error IDENT
function fail_on_zero(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n >= 0
aborts NotFound
ensures error = NotFound or success
is
    if n = 0 then
        return error NotFound
    end if
    return ok n
end fail_on_zero

-- RES-03: .value Accessor
function extract_value(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    let r: Result<Integer, NotFound> = ok_integer(n)
    let v: Integer = r.value
    return v
end extract_value

-- RES-04: .error Accessor
function extract_error() returns Integer
aborts NotFound
is
    let r: Result<Integer, NotFound> = fail_on_zero(0)
    return 0
end extract_error

-- RES-07: value / error / success / failure als Primärausdrücke
function keyword_primaries(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n >= 0
ensures success, value >= 0
is
    let s: Boolean = true
    let f: Boolean = false
    return ok n
end keyword_primaries

end Test.Results.Pos
